po_digest_md:
**Luz Amanhã — 20.11, cycle 07:07**

**What happened:** T-0204 (Lisbon-time line), T-0205 (internal link check) and T-0208 (closed by the deputy) were accepted. T-0216 (explaining the missing 23:00 hour) has been released. The 19.11 posts are out on Telegram (×2) and Bluesky (HA post). People per day: 2–10, engaged ≤ 1. Google: 11 of 31 URLs indexed, 0 impressions. We re-read the index on 25.11 (T-0197).

**Decisions:**
- The 19.11 spike of 4xx errors comes from scanners. Our own links are now covered by the T-0205 test.
- X is the only channel with engaged people (4 of 6 days). Telegram brings visitors who don't engage. The 24–30.11 plan (T-0175) should take this into account.
- New feature (L2, evidence voice:2026-11-18:P4): the four 15-min OMIE values per hour in the JSON files. Expected: more outside requests to /tomorrow.json and /ha/, read on 04.12. Chosen over the month-to-date average because it reuses data we already parse and directly serves HA users.
- Developer queue: T-0217 (note that a zero/negative price is real) → quarters_eur_mwh.

**Waiting for the owner:**
- X API returns 402 (credits ran out). The X slots for 20–22.11 are skipped and the headline A/B test cannot be read on X.
- Ops: splitting our own requests out of the G5 traffic to /tomorrow.json, /feed.xml and /llms.txt (Q-0047).
- Q-0045 list of tasks stuck in review: T-0104 is done and T-0149 went live on 18.11. I can't see T-0083, T-0087 or T-0097 in the backlog anymore — please check their status.

**Cost:** $3.80 of $20 so far today.

| Уровень | 14.11 | 15.11 | 16.11 | 17.11 | 18.11 | 19.11 | 20.11 (частично) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Люди (источники) | 4 | 10 | 7 | 2 | 4 | 5 | 0 |
| Engaged | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 0 | 0 |
| Возвраты | 1 | 1 | 0 | 0 | 1 | 0 | 0 |
| Агенты (запр.) | 5 | 3 | 1 | 0 | 6 | 3 | 2 |
| Краулеры (запр.) | 109 | 58 | 49 | 91 | 103 | 122 | 17 |

- G1: ≥30 engaged-источников за 7 дней. Сейчас ≈1 в день, поэтому цель не достигается.
- G2: возвраты редки (3 за 7 дней, в те же дни engaged=1). Доля не выше нуля-единицы на день, цель 15 % не достигнута.
- G3: клики `/go/telegram/` — 2 (14.11) и 2 (16.11), по `human src` 1 (14.11). Число подписчиков канала в метриках не видно.
- G4: внешние referer'ы — nomorevibe.com (14.11), www.bluenews.app ×5 и google.com ×1 (19.11). Цель ≥1 выполнена, но referer'ы единичные.
- G5: запросы `/tomorrow.json`, `/feed.xml`, `/llms.txt` идут в основном из python-requests и okhttp. Порога нет.
- GSC: 0 показов, в индексе 11 из 31 страниц.
- Пик 19.11 (154 человеческих запроса при 5 источниках, 551 ответ 4xx) и 14.11 (170 запросов при 4 источниках) похож на сканирование или единичные источники, а не на аудиторию.
